info.title: Duit API
info.description: Backend API for Duit, an AI-powered personal finance and receipt-based bill splitting app.

post.description: Requires bearer authentication, the current password, CSRF, and an approved Origin or Referer. Returns a no-store ZIP archive.
Requires bearer authentication, current-password confirmation, the exact deletion phrase, CSRF, and an approved Origin or Referer.

post.summary: Register and start a browser session
post.description: Returns a short-lived access token and sets an opaque HttpOnly refresh cookie. The refresh token is never returned in JSON.

Requires the host-only refresh cookie, the CSRF header obtained from /auth/csrf, an approved Origin or Referer, and a canonical X-Refresh-Request-ID. A successful response rotates the refresh cookie and returns a new short-lived access token.

post.summary: Revoke and clear the browser session
post.description: Works without a valid access token. Requires the refresh cookie, CSRF header, and an approved Origin or Referer. The operation is idempotent and clears session cookies.

post.summary: Authenticate and start a browser session
post.description: Returns a short-lived access token and sets an opaque HttpOnly refresh cookie. The refresh token is never returned in JSON.

get.description: Returns the masked CSRF token used by refresh and logout. The matching HttpOnly CSRF cookie is set by the server.

amount.description: Positive plain decimal string. Surrounding whitespace is normalized; maximum scale 4 and maximum 99999999.9999.

fxRate.description: Positive plain decimal string in MYR per source-currency unit; maximum scale 6 and maximum 9999.999999.

amount.description: User-confirmed positive receipt total as a plain decimal string; maximum scale 4.

fxRate.description: Positive plain decimal string in MYR per source-currency unit; maximum scale 6.

token.description: Short-lived JWT access token. Clients must keep it in memory only.

expiresAt.description: Nominal JWT expiry. This does not include validation clock skew.

fxRate.description: Positive plain decimal string with maximum scale 6.
